ExtractAgainRequest.description:
``mode`` (D8): ``replace`` saves the new reading into the thread's test (the default when
no other thread uses it); ``copy`` makes a new test for this thread only.
ExtractAgainRequest.title: ExtractAgainRequest

KeyCheck.description:
What ``verify_key`` said when it did not confirm the key (data-model v1.24, step 22.5.5).

``disagreed``: the checker's own ``answer`` and its ``reasoning``. ``unsure``: the checker
answered ``?`` (step 22.6.3, D6), so only its ``reasoning`` is kept. ``did_not_finish``: the
check was cut off or failed twice, so there is no answer (both ``None``).
KeyCheck.title: KeyCheck

ListeningSkipped.description: The printed range of the listening part left out of the test (step 22.5.6).
ListeningSkipped.title: ListeningSkipped

OmittedSection.description: A section left out of points_possible: listening (not stored) or writing (graded=False).
OmittedSection.title: OmittedSection

ReportGrade.description: The grade report as people read it: skill names, no taxonomy codes in the text.
ReportGrade.title: ReportGrade

ReportWeakPoint.description: A stored weak point with the skill's English name (the code stays for internal use).
ReportWeakPoint.title: ReportWeakPoint

SkillPaper.description: One paper's result for a skill (D11b): the date taken and the share right.
SkillPaper.title: SkillPaper

StudentDeletePreview.description:
What ``DELETE /students/{id}`` removes: ``threads`` go whole; ``kept_threads`` are shared
with another student and lose only this student's attempts; ``attempt_count`` is the
attempts (papers) that go, current or superseded.
StudentDeletePreview.title: StudentDeletePreview

StudentSkill.description: A skill on the Students tab (D11b, D11e; v4.45).
StudentSkill.title: StudentSkill

StudentSummary.description: A student with the number of threads whose current attempt is theirs (v4.26).
StudentSummary.title: StudentSummary

TestDeletePreview.title: TestDeletePreview

TestPageRef.description: One original page photo of a test (llm-design v4.21): its page number and stored file.
TestPageRef.title: TestPageRef

TestWithPaths.description:
``GET /tests/{id}``: the test plus each picture's stored path (llm-design v4.10) and the
original page photos (v4.21).

``picture_paths`` maps a ``PictureRef.file_id`` to its ``files`` row path
(``files/<id[:2]>/<id>.<ext>``), so the D11 placeholder names the real extension.
A picture whose file row is missing is left out.

``pages`` is every ``test_pages`` row by ``page_no``: the prepared page the test was
extracted from (already turned by the photo check's rotation and resized; a text-only page's
``file_id`` is its text file). ``key_pages`` is every ``test_key_pages`` row by ``page_no``:
the key photos the test was extracted with (data-model v1.12; llm-design v4.27). Tests
extracted before v1.12 have none.
TestWithPaths.title: TestWithPaths

ThreadRef.description: A thread as other lists name it: the delete preview, a student's threads.
ThreadRef.title: ThreadRef

ThreadRename.description: A new title; ``null`` goes back to the automatic title (llm-design v4.25).
ThreadRename.title: ThreadRename
